items.t: Charging unit (ICCU) failure and loss of drive power (recall)
items.job: ICCU inspection, software update and replacement (recall)

items.t: Battery cells can have a fire risk (recall)
Battery bus bar bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten battery bus bar bolts (recall)

items.t: 'Power is limited' warning or whine from the rear motor
items.job: Diagnose power-limited warning and inspect drive unit oil pump
items.note: Parts are usually covered by Hyundai's EV warranty (10 years/100,000 miles for original owners); a replacement rear motor out of warranty would cost thousands.

items.t: Rear driveshaft can break (recall)
Car can roll away after being put in Park (recall)
Rear suspension bolts may loosen (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten rear suspension bolts (recall)

items.t: Front seat belt retractors may not be secured (recall)
Rear side airbag may not deploy (recall)
Right headlight may be aimed wrong (recall)
Ioniq 5 N brake software fault (recall)
Instrument display may not show speed or warnings (recall)
12-volt battery goes flat and the car won't wake up
items.job: Test 12V battery and charging system; replace 12V battery if weak
items.note: RepairPal lists about $122-$179 for an electrical system diagnosis. A new 12-volt battery adds about $150-$300.

items.t: Heater or A/C stops working
items.job: Diagnose and repair heater/A/C per bulletin
items.note: Covered under warranty; parts cost depends on the failed component.

items.t: Charging port caps missing or damaged
Jerky or hesitant response in Eco mode (AWD)
Noise from the steering column when turning
items.job: Replace steering column worm shaft bearing
items.note: Covered under warranty on most cars.

items.t: Rattle from the tailgate
items.job: Add tailgate washer pads and adjust striker

items.t: Active air flap warning
Driver's power seat stops moving
items.job: Inspect and repair seat wiring harness

items.t: Touch screen freezes or radio app crashes
items.note: You can often install the update yourself for free.
